limitations: Ceff130-220uF and ESR1-30mOhm are sizing envelopes, not measured converter output impedance. Unknown module/cable capacitors are excluded.

The simple transconductance/current-source model omits inner current-loop poles, sampling, DCM/PFM, delay, distributed ESR/ESL and parasitics; its apparent phase margins are not a stability certificate.
10nF series compensation and 470pF high-frequency pole are prototype starting values. Measure loop gain/load-step response at cable/load/temperature corners before release.
5A is the IC rating, not proven board capability. Peak current uses nominal L/frequency only; verify tolerance, inductor saturation and thermal rise.
Conduction numbers omit switching, quiescent, inductor, diode, copper and connector losses. No junction temperature is certified.
Input startup/stall/inrush and fuse temperature derating are unmeasured; 0.16A assumed continuous fuse headroom is small. Stage module startup and test, do not silently raise F1.
5V Type-C is 3A current advertisement, no PD/PPS negotiation. 150uF bulk remains at TPS25810 IN and 10uF at OUT per TI8.2.1.1.1.
Schematic, resource audit, PCB synchronization, native DRC and physical verification are separate. No manufacturing or full system validation claimed.
Maix supply nominal0.9986A has tolerance; recognition plus charging can cause brownout. Remove J27 before powered USB debug; battery can keep module alive.
J18 and SW2-SW5 exact purchase/lead geometry and TFT hole pitch need confirmation; generic model bodies are not exact supplier models.
